assessments.reasoning: Section 5.9 gives equal-sized vectors element-wise results and treats the right vector of compatible matrix multiplication as a column. Section 5.10 expands that exact orientation. For vectors (1,2,3) and (4,5,6) the component products are (4,10,18). Rows (1,2,0), (0,1,3), (4,0,1) acting on (1,2,3) yield (5,11,7). These source-derived examples distinguish component-wise and linear operations without testing shader execution.

limitations: The claim leaves mixed scalar types, mismatched dimensions, numerical precision and the separate matrix component multiplication function outside scope.
